summary: Initializes a 45-entry array of 5-dword (20-byte) tire-grip data records anchored 8 bytes below global dword_8AF570. Each record is filled with sentinel values (dword 0 at offset 0, -1 at offsets 4, 8 and 12, byte 0 at offset 16) while StringCopyWithBufferRealloc is called with byte_5EA438 on every iteration; the last call result is returned.

local_names.v0: current record pointer, advancing by 5 dwords per iteration
local_names.v1: iteration counter, starts at 45 and counts down to 0
local_names.result: return value, last result of StringCopyWithBufferRealloc

operations.description: Loop exactly 45 times over 5-dword records starting 8 bytes below dword_8AF570, advancing the record pointer by 5 dwords each pass.
Write 0 to the first dword of the current record (8 bytes below dword_8AF570 at iteration 0).
Write -1 to the second dword of the current record (4 bytes below dword_8AF570 at iteration 0).
Call StringCopyWithBufferRealloc with byte_5EA438 on every iteration; discard or carry the returned result.
Write -1 to the third dword of the current record (dword_8AF570 at iteration 0).
Write -1 to the fourth dword of the current record (4 bytes above dword_8AF570 at iteration 0).
Write 0 to the byte at offset 8 within the current record (byte offset 16 of the record).
Return the last result produced by StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
